title: Refuse new-session writes when the adopted frozen legacy log is missing (113)
description: Refuse new-session writes when the adopted frozen legacy log is missing (113)
no_spec_change_rationale: Repair existing REQ-history-002 acceptance: unexpected anchor changes refuse new writes, together with independent session history REQ-history-006. The missing frozen log is a mismatch with remembered adoption proof. No canonical wording, HI, CLI/schema, retention authorization or new lifecycle policy is introduced; source/test repair implements the existing contract.
acceptance_criteria: Find a remembered legacy adoption anchor independently of whether transitions.jsonl currently exists. With a valid adoption holder open, archived, shelved or in its existing supported vault location, deleting that frozen log must refuse a new session append before checkpoint/cursor/active-pointer or event bytes change. Preserve original adopting-session refusal and changed-byte mismatch refusal. Intact/restored logs permit new-session writes, and genuinely new projects with no adoption anchor/log still work with legacy:null. Preserve each session own independent lineage; no anchor copying, immutable record rewrite, new schema, broad archive scan or weakened bounds/path protections. Add meaningful committed regression before the production patch and prove same assertions RED then GREEN on an actually built exact-source artifact only under a separate root lease. Keep old tests/assertions and failed receipts. Current older-runtime private8 controls are qualified evidence only, not current-main execution. Update only the allocated per-change cases/changelog/INDEX and own records, freeze clean exact SHA, and return for different-author review; human acceptance/delivery remain separate.

answers.constraints: Existing REQ-history-002 and REQ-history-006; preserve independent legacy-null new sessions, bounded existing open/archive/shelved/vault holder lookup and existing unreadable/invalid-holder policy. Refuse missing/changed adopted log before event/checkpoint/cursor/active-pointer writes; preserve intact/restored/never-adopted positives. Exact eight affected paths only; no canonical HI/spec wording, schema/CLI/policy or immutable archive/history rewrite. Fledge-first, isolated source, committed meaningful current-source RED before minimal patch and same GREEN; separate exclusive build lease; preserve old assertions, failures and exact tool/source identities. Root coordinator scope authority under Leif all-issues request; no agent human acceptance/review or public delivery. These constraints restate reviewed plan/design; no new product decision.
